model.name: CR1: Rename 'Champagne Chain' label to 'Traceability Chain' in all user-facing UI.
model.description: CHANGE REQUEST: the detail-view section labeled 'Champagne Chain' uses internal measurement jargon in USER-FACING UI. 'Champagne' is the team's internal quality-verification concept — users don't know what it means. RENAME to 'Traceability Chain' everywhere in the product UI. Champagne/marketing terms must NOT appear in the product interface (only in internal scoring/audit tools).
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "do you see the issues on this requirement and the need for change requests and bugs regarding traceability and stupid champagne marketing?"
model.crossRefNote: R20.5 (universal chain-vs-children) already specified 'Traceability' as the label. CR1 is the explicit change-request to rename the existing 'Champagne Chain' label.

intendedChain.useCase: detailView.renameChainLabel — 'Champagne Chain' → 'Traceability Chain' in all detail-view templates
intendedChain.method: renderTraceabilitySection — change the section heading string
intendedChain.test: RED: open any detail-view → assert section heading is 'Traceability Chain' (or 'Traceability'), NOT 'Champagne Chain'. Currently FAILS (some views show 'Champagne Chain').
